stem:
The table shows the heights and masses of a male gorilla and a female gorilla at a zoo.

Gorillas

|         | Height (m) | Mass (kg) |
|---------|------------|-----------|
| Male    | 1.68       | 158.757   |
| Female  | 1.448      | 95.25     |

Based on the table, which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The combined mass of the male gorilla and the female gorilla is 253.782 kg.

options.label: G
options.text: The mass of the male gorilla is 63.507 kg greater than the mass of the female gorilla.

options.label: H
options.text: The female gorilla is 1.28 m shorter than the male gorilla.

options.label: J
options.text: The combined height of the male gorilla and the female gorilla is 2.028 m.

visual_elements: table showing heights and masses of male and female gorillas
